meta.name: Summarize multi-channel Slack standups with OpenAI and post and escalate digests

name: Multi-Channel Standup Digest with Blocker Escalation

parameters.content:
## Multi-Channel Standup Digest with Blocker Escalation
Reads your team's channels, turns the chatter into a clean Shipped / Blockers / Next Up digest, posts it, and separately alerts a lead when something is actually blocked. Stays quiet on days with no activity.

## How it works
1. Runs on a schedule, or on demand from the manual trigger
2. Reads every channel listed in your config - one unreachable channel does not stop the others
3. Filters to your time window and flags messages matching your blocker keywords
4. No activity? It stops, rather than posting an empty digest
5. AI returns a structured digest, which is posted to your digest channel
6. If there are real blockers, a separate alert goes to your escalation channel

## Setup
- [ ] Connect Slack credentials to all three Slack nodes
- [ ] Connect OpenAI credentials in OpenAI Chat Model
- [ ] Open Standup Config and set your source channel IDs, digest channel, escalation channel, time window, and blocker keywords
- [ ] Adjust the schedule if 9am weekdays is not right

## Customize
Everything lives in Standup Config. Add channels by appending IDs to SourceChannelIds. Tune what counts as a blocker with BlockerKeywords - the AI also judges independently, and either one triggers the alert.

## 1. Collect
Scheduled or on demand. Every configured channel is read independently, then messages are merged, filtered to the time window, and scanned for blocker keywords.

## 2. Summarize
Quiet day? It stops here instead of posting an empty digest. Otherwise the AI returns structured JSON, which is parsed into a digest - and falls back to raw messages if the model returns something unreadable.

## 3. Post & Escalate
The digest always goes to the team channel. A separate alert only fires when something is genuinely blocked.

assignments.name: BlockerKeywords
assignments.value: blocked, blocker, stuck, waiting on, need help, cannot proceed
